---
title: "Argentina"
---

```{r setup}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pacman::p_load(zoo, dplyr, ggplot2, scales, plotly, knitr)
source("../../R/plots.R")
LOGO <- "../../XKDRORGFILES/XKDR_Logomark_RGB_Full_Colour.png"
res  <- readRDS("../../results/ARG.rds")$fit
```

Currency-basket weights for the ARS, estimated with the structural-break regression framework of @zeileis2010testing (R package `fxregime`) on weekly returns expressed in NZD. Sample: 1995-01-02 to 2026-10-21.

::: {.text-end style="margin-bottom: 10px;"}
[Download R Script](ARG_script.R){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm download="ARG_script.R"}
[Download input data](ARG_fx_data.csv){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm download="ARG_fx_data.csv"}
:::

## ARS/USD level

```{r levels}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| column: page-right

plot_level(res, "ARS/USD Rate", LOGO)
```

## Structural breaks

```{r breaks}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| column: page-right

tab <- res$regimes[, setdiff(names(res$regimes), c("start", "end"))]
knitr::kable(
  tab, digits = 3, format = "html",
  table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover"',
  caption = "Estimated currency weights and R² by regime"
)
```

```{r note}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (nzchar(res$note)) cat("*Note:*", res$note, "\n")
```

::: {.text-end style="margin-top: 10px;"}
[Download Table as CSV](ARG_regimes.csv){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm download="ARG_regimes.csv"}
:::

```{r weights}
#| echo: false
```
